handoffs.title: Units from getbuild
handoffs.description: New homes you bought through a getbuild developer and chose to rent out. Each one starts as a listing draft with the developer's facts.

empty.title: No units from getbuild yet
empty.description: When a developer that uses getbuild hands over your unit, its invitation link lands here once you claim it.

claim.title: Rent out your new unit
claim.description: getbuild told us about this unit. Add the rent and a headline — we make a listing draft you finish with photos.
claim.formHint: Everything here can be changed later in the listing.
claim.rentHint: What you ask per month. getbuild does not send a price.
claim.rentInvalid: Type the rent in baht, e.g. 15000
claim.titleHint: Suggested from the unit's facts — edit it as you like.

address.title: Address of the unit
address.why: getbuild did not tell us the full address. Renters see the building's address on the listing.

claim.after: Free for landlords. Nothing is published until you submit the listing.

landlordRequired.title: Claim it with a landlord account
landlordRequired.body: This account is an apartment business or an agency. A unit you bought yourself goes into a free landlord account — switch to it, or sign up one with your phone.

invalidState.title: This invitation can no longer be used
invalidState.body: It was claimed, declined or has expired. If you still want to rent the unit out, add it in your portfolio.

unknown.title: We could not find this invitation
unknown.body: The link may be incomplete or out of date. Open it again from getbuild's buyer portal.

claim.closedBody: Nothing more to do here. Your listings show every unit you rent out.
claim.unitSource: As getbuild described it at the transfer.

employers.title: Employer housing
employers.description: Companies that pay for their workers' rooms. Invoices of the leases you attach are addressed to the employer, with a statement and payroll file each month.
employers.noCompanyBody: An employer is a company among your people. Add it with its tax ID, then come back to record the agreement.

empty.title: No employer agreements
empty.description: Record one when a company pays for the rooms its workers stay in.

workers.empty: Nobody is staying under the attached leases yet.
workers.notStaying: No longer on an attached lease

employers.lawNote: Deducting rent from wages is the employer's decision and responsibility under labour law; getproperty only shares the figures.
employers.genericCsv: CSV (employee no., name, unit, invoice, share, deduction)
employers.leasesTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No leases attached} one {# lease attached} other {# leases attached}}
employers.leasesHint: Attach a lease from its page: “Who pays”.
employers.noLeases: Open a lease of a worker and attach it to this employer.
employers.workersHint: The employer's own payroll number for each person staying, as it appears in their HR system.

form.newHint: The employer receives the invoices of the leases you attach to it.
form.buildingHint: Only leases in this building can be attached.

splitHint.per_occupant: Each invoice is split equally between everyone staying under the lease (the first person takes the satang left over).
splitHint.per_unit: The whole invoice is the lessee's share.

form.deductHint: The share of each worker's portion the employer takes from wages (0–100).
form.deductInvalid: Use a number from 0 to 100 with up to two decimals
form.referenceHint: e.g. their HR or purchase order number
form.deductDisclaimer: Whether the employer may deduct from wages, and how much, is between the employer and its workers under labour law.
form.editHint: Changes apply to invoices issued from now on.
form.endBody: {count, plural, =0 {No lease is attached.} one {The attached lease goes back to its lessee for the next invoices.} other {The # attached leases go back to their lessees for the next invoices.}} Issued invoices stay as they are. Type the employer's name to confirm.

statement.title: Statement · {month}
statement.hint: Invoices addressed to the employer that were issued this month, split per worker.
statement.empty: No invoices were issued to this employer in this month.

lease.title: Who pays
lease.hint: Invoices of this lease go to the lessee, or to an employer paying for its worker.
lease.current: Paid by <link>{name}</link> — {percent} of each worker's share is recovered through payroll.
lease.attachHint: Invoices issued from now on are addressed to the employer. Issued invoices never change.
lease.detachBody: From the next invoice the lessee pays again. Issued invoices stay addressed as they are.
lease.detached: The lessee pays this lease again
